# f5xc_dns_zone_record (Resource)

F5XC DNS Management RRSet API APIs to create, update or delete individual records of a DNS zone without having to send the whole DNS zone information.

To get more information about f5xc_dns_zone_record, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/rrset)

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_dns_zone_record.example <dns_zone_name>/<group_name>/<record_name>/<type>
```

### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<dns_zone_name>/<group_name>/<record_name>/<type>"
	to = "f5xc_dns_zone_record.example"
}
```
